BlackFridayThumbnailClean.png|Default skin on a render. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The Default skin appearance was based on the [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/Commando Commando] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.[[File:CommandoReferenceProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/589292970541318185/603740113301929984 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) *The original Level 3 and Level 4 {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin shared the same clothing with the [[Swordmaster]]. *The Level 1 icon shows the Default skin with a missile launcher and a red headband, however, the missile launcher is not obtained until Level 3, while the red headband never appears on the skin. *The {{Color|Mission|Trooper}} skin is based on the [https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Clone_commando Clone commandos] from ''Star Wars''. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The original Level 0-4 Default pistols were the {{RLinkC|2569022418|Twin Space Pistols}} gear from the Roblox catalog. **The original Level 0-4 {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} pistols were the {{RLinkC|16726984|Pirate's Flintlock}} gear from the Roblox catalog. **The original Level 5 {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} pistols were the {{RLinkC|17237675|Captain's Flintlock}} gear from the Roblox catalog. *The original Level 5 Default helmet was the {{RLinkC|17735403|Exoflex Spax Helmex}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. **The original Level 4 Default helmet was a re-textured version of it. *The pirate hat on the original Level 4 {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} was the {{RLinkC|1028859|Pirate Captain's Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The eyepatch on the original Level 2-5 {{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin was the {{RLinkC|74970669|Eyepatch}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Commando]]. Check the main article for statistical changes.'' {{scroll|text = *'''9 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.0]] **'''Commando''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Default icon changed. **New skin: {{Color|Premium|Pirate}} *'''1 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.2]] **[[April Fools 2020|Funny Faces]] added. *'''2 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.8|Release v1.8.2a]] **[[April Fools 2020|Funny Faces]] removed. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Default and {{Color|Premium|Pirate}} Level 0-5 appearance changed. *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **All skins Level 0-5 appearance changed. *'''5 August 2023''' - [[v1.8.4]] **{{Color|Pirate|Pirate}} skin moved to the [[Pirate Crate]]. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **Updated explosion visual effects. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **All skins' Level 0-4 appearance changed (Level 5 removed). **Level 0-4 upgrade icons changed. **New skin: {{Color|Mission|Trooper}} **{{Bug}} Default skin has z-fighting in its torso at Level 0-3. **{{Bug}} Upgrading a Level 3 '''Commando''' to Level 4 while it is attacking an enemy will make it use the Level 3 animation for the burst cooldown instead of the Level 4 animation. **{{Bug}} Missile landing and explosion sounds are not affected by the [[Settings#Towers|Towers]] sound setting. }} ==Notes== {{TowerNavBox}} {{ShadowTOC}}
